author: Nostalgia Nerd
description:
If you're a fan of Mini Arcade Machines, then good news! Quarter Arcades Battlezone is here, and I wanted to test it out before it goes into production. BUT THERE MIGHT BE A PROBLEM. Maybe some games work best if they're not Quarter Sized? 

I also take a look at Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Quarter Arcade and Elevator Action Quarter Arcade that I've had knocking around for a while, but haven't had a chance to setup, because those are two of my favourite games ever, and they need to be out on show.

Thank you to Numskull for sending me a pre-production unit to look at and assess.
